prepare_ljspeech_dataset: run the LJSpeech dataset preparation script to preprocess audio and text into arrow format
filter_audio_duration: filter audio files by duration to exclude samples shorter than 0.4 seconds or longer than 30 seconds
save_arrow_dataset: save preprocessed dataset records to an arrow file using ArrowWriter for efficient storage
generate_duration_json: create a duration.json file containing a list of all audio durations for DynamicBatchSampler usage
build_vocab_file: generate a sorted vocab.txt tokenizer file from all unique characters in the normalized text
